provider: Senatsverwaltung für Mobilität, Verkehr, Klimaschutz und Umwelt Berlin (Umweltatlas)
attribution: Senatsverwaltung für Mobilität, Verkehr, Klimaschutz und Umwelt Berlin, Umweltatlas Berlin: Verkehrsmengen 2019 (DTV), WFS ua_verkehrsmengen_2019, Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero – 2.0; transformed to EPSG:4326.

limitations: Measures motor-vehicle traffic only: average daily traffic (DTV, Kfz) in vehicles/day, plus per-class DTV. It does NOT measure pedestrians, cyclists, footfall or customer potential.

Reference year 2019 (pre-pandemic). Values are compiled from the Verkehrsmengenkarte 2019, VISUM traffic-model outputs and counts dated 2017–2019 (field herkunft); they are not current or live traffic.
Covers the classified main road network (about 10.4k segments), not every residential street; a street without a segment has unknown traffic, not zero.
DTV is reported per segment as published; direction split is not provided. Straight-line distance to a segment is not walking time.
Source access, CRS, paging and field mapping checked 2026-10-18.
